sql: SELECT a.analyst_name, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN d.outcome = 'accept' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) * 100, 1) AS ftr FROM caseflow.documents d JOIN caseflow.analysts a ON a.analyst_id = d.reviewed_by WHERE d.reviewed_at >= DATE '2026-10-01' AND d.reviewed_at < DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY a.analyst_name ORDER BY ftr DESC, a.analyst_name LIMIT 1
explanation: The analyst whose October reviews were most often accepted first time.
assumptions: Credited to the analyst who reviewed each document
